blogs.title: Why Patches Beat Tokens: A Friendly Intro to Byte Latent Transformer (BLT)
blogs.description: An accessible overview of BLT’s core idea—processing raw bytes with dynamic patches instead of fixed tokens. Explains why tokenization can be brittle (noise sensitivity, multilingual inequity) and how BLT avoids vocabularies altogether while matching token-based LLMs at scale.

blogs.title: Entropy as a Compass: How BLT Decides Where to Think Hard
blogs.description: A deep dive into entropy-based patching. Walks through how a small byte LM scores next-byte uncertainty to set patch boundaries, why first-bytes-in-words tend to be ‘hard,’ and how dynamic patch sizes let BLT spend more compute on complex parts and less on predictable stretches.

blogs.title: Inside BLT’s Architecture: Local Byte Models Meet a Global Latent Transformer
blogs.description: Explains BLT’s three-block design: lightweight local encoder/decoder around a large global latent transformer. Covers cross-attention pooling from bytes to patches, n-gram hash embeddings for byte context, and how decoding maps latent patches back into raw bytes efficiently.

blogs.title: Scaling Without Tokens: FLOPs, Patch Size, and Why BLT Gets Cheaper at Inference
blogs.description: Unpacks BLT’s flop-controlled scaling results up to 8B parameters and 4T bytes. Explains how increasing patch size reduces steps for the global transformer, enabling up to ~50% inference flop savings while keeping performance on par with Llama 3 in compute-matched regimes.

blogs.title: Fixed Inference Budget, Bigger Models: BLT’s New Scaling Frontier
blogs.description: Shows how BLT can simultaneously grow model and patch size under a fixed inference budget. Walks through fixed-inference scaling experiments, when BLT overtakes BPE models after modest extra pretraining, and why larger patches improve as models get bigger.

blogs.title: Stronger on the Long Tail: BLT’s Robustness to Noise, Spelling, and Low-Resource Languages
blogs.description: Highlights robustness gains from byte modeling: resilience to character-level noise, superior performance on CUTE and G2P tasks, and better BLEU on many low-resource translation pairs. Explains why direct byte awareness improves orthography and long-tail generalization.

blogs.title: From Tokens to Bytes: ‘Byte-ifying’ Llama 3 with BLT
blogs.description: Explores initializing BLT’s global transformer from a pre-trained Llama 3.1 to reduce training costs. Covers the workflow, what improves out of the box, where performance still drops, and practical tips for data mixtures and hyperparameters to get the most from this path.

blogs.title: Patching Methods Compared: Strided, Space, BPE-Inspired, and Entropy
blogs.description: Compares different patching strategies across efficiency and quality. Explains where space patching shines, why strided patching struggles, what makes entropy patching state-of-the-art, and how BLT keeps byte-level context length comparable across methods for fair tests.

blogs.title: What Builders Need to Know: Training, Inference, and Deploying BLT in Practice
blogs.description: A pragmatic guide to adopting BLT: entropy model choices, context equalization, handling dynamic patch ratios in batching, using FlexAttention for dynamic masks, tuning n-gram hash embeddings, and picking patch sizes to balance pretraining cost vs. inference efficiency.
